scene street_noon
: Hello?
: {i}Sensei, good evening.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}老师，晚上好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I was just having a bit of a chat with your beautiful, four-eyed assistant and felt compelled to call after realizing just how frequently the two of you make passionate love to one another.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我刚跟您那位漂亮的四眼助手聊了两句，意识到你们俩缠绵的次数有多么频繁，就忍不住想打个电话给您。{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...that’s not really-
lines.zh: : 呃……那其实不是——

lines.en: : {i}Anyway, how are things? Are you doing well? Any plans for the rest of the night?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之，近来可好？您过得怎么样？今晚余下的时间有什么安排吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Can we maybe get back to the thing you just said about Makoto?
lines.zh: : 我们能先回到你刚才说 Makoto 的那件事上吗？

lines.en: : {i}Perhaps another time. We need not involve her in our personal affairs when she is but a mere gateway to their introduction.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}改天吧。她不过是个引子，用来引出我们的私事罢了，没必要把她牵扯进来。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I follow, but no. I don’t have any plans for the rest of the night. I’m just...walking around. The same way I always do after school.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白你的意思，不过没有。我今晚余下的时间没什么安排。只是在……到处走走。跟平时放学后一个样。

lines.en: : {i}Would you be opposed to coming back to school?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您介意回学校一趟吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Depends on what I’d be coming back for.
lines.zh: : 看是回来干什么。

lines.en: : {i}Ahh. So my presence alone is not enough to intrigue you? What a shame. I’m freshly showered and everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊。这么说，光是有我在还不足以勾起您的兴趣？真遗憾。我可是刚洗完澡呢。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Plus, the conversation and stark realization of your lecherous tendencies with a dear friend of mine has awakened something in me that I would very much like to share with you...as soon as possible.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再者，刚才那场对话，加上我对您和我一位好友之间那点色欲倾向的清醒认知，唤醒了我体内某种东西，我非常想尽快跟您分享……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I guess the simplest way of putting it is that I have a bit of a present for you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想最简单的说法是——我有件小礼物要送给您。{/i}

lines.en: : You...
: Am I hearing that correctly? Because that sounds-
lines.zh: : 我没听错吧？因为听起来——

lines.en: : {i}How quickly can you make it to the pool? It wouldn’t be very kind to keep me waiting when I’m utterly quaking with anticipation, you know.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}您最快多久能到泳池？要知道我正兴奋得浑身发抖，让我等可不是什么体贴的事。{/i}

lines.en: : I am on my way right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就过去。

lines.en: : {i}Heh...I knew you would be.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呵……我就知道您会。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, and I’m sure it goes without saying, but don’t tell anyone about this. Do you understand?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，这想必不用我多说——别告诉任何人。您明白吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’d like to keep as many eyes off of me as possible. I am still a lady, you know? Even if I’m about to do very...unladylike things.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我希望越少人盯着我看越好。我好歹还是个淑女，您说呢？哪怕我马上要做的都是些……很不淑女的事。{/i}

lines.en: : You have my word.
lines.zh: : 我保证。

lines.en: : {i}Excellent.{/i}
: {i}I’ve left the door unlocked for you, so feel free to wander right in and storm up to me with no restraint at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}门我给您留着没锁，您尽管直接进来，毫无顾忌地冲到我面前就好。{/i}

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 明白。我们很快见。

lines.en: : {i}Oh, you sure will...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，您一定会见到我的……{/i}

lines.en: I hang up the phone and figure there is about a 50%% chance of there being some sort of catch to this, but I’m honestly too excited at this point to even worry about that.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，估摸着这事大概有五成的概率藏着什么陷阱，不过说实话，我此刻已经兴奋到顾不上担心了。

lines.en: scene black
I’m also too excited to worry about the fact that Nodoka just...also knows about Makoto and me now for some reason.
lines.zh: 同样地，我也兴奋到顾不上去想另一件事——不知怎么的，Nodoka 现在居然也知道了 Makoto 和我的事。

lines.en: But hey, if believing that Makoto has finally one-upped her in some way is what Nodoka needed to just give in and finally sleep with me, that’s totally fine.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果 Nodoka 需要的只是相信 Makoto 终于在某方面赢了她一次，好让她就此缴械、终于跟我上床，那也完全没问题。

lines.en: It was only a matter of time anyway.
lines.zh: 反正迟早的事。

lines.en: Did I think that time would come after a random school day when I was minding my own business and not even {i}thinking{/i} about Nodoka? Of course not.
lines.zh: 我有没有想过，那一刻会降临在某个再普通不过的放学后，当时我正忙着自己的事，压根没在{i}想{/i} Nodoka？当然没有。

lines.en: But, given the type of person she is...and the type of person {i}I{/i} am...of course it would happen like this.
lines.zh: 不过，考虑到她是什么样的人……{i}我{/i}又是什么样的人……当然会是这样发生的。

lines.en: I turn off my inner monologue and focus on one thing-
lines.zh: 我关掉内心的独白，把注意力集中在一件事上——

lines.en: Getting to the school as quickly as possible.
lines.zh: 尽快赶到学校。

lines.en: scene nodokaspresent1
When I arrive, all of the lights in the pool room are off.
lines.zh: 我到的时候，泳池房里的灯全关着。

lines.en: And since the sun has already begun to set, the amount of natural light in here is practically non-existent.
lines.zh: 而太阳已经开始西沉，这里的自然光几乎等于零。

lines.en: It’s replaced by the faint blue glow of dim fluorescent light reflecting off of the water and onto the glass-based tiles, which then reflect the light {i}again{/i} until it roams around infinitely.
lines.zh: 取而代之的，是昏暗荧光灯映在水面上、{i}再{/i}反射到玻璃砖上的淡淡蓝光，然后又被反复反射，直到光在里面无限游走。

lines.en: But amidst the infinite light, the one thing I do {i}not{/i} see is the one thing I {i}came{/i} here to see, proving that my intuition in believing this to be a setup was likely true.
lines.zh: 可在这无限的光里，我唯独{i}看不到{/i}我{i}此行{/i}要见的那样东西——这证明我关于这是个圈套的直觉大概是对的。

lines.en: Either that or Nodoka is just...fucking with me and is still planning on giving me her virginity. Which seems like a pretty {i}Nodoka{/i} thing to do.
lines.zh: 要么就是 Nodoka 只是在……耍我，而她依然打算把处女之身交给我。这倒像是 {i}Nodoka{/i} 会干的事。

lines.en: I should call her and find out.
lines.zh: 我该给她打个电话问清楚。

lines.en: I tap on her name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我戳下手机里她的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : {i}Hellooooo?{/i}
: Hey. Where are you?

lines.en: : That’s...

lines.zh: : 那不是我会做的事。

lines.en: : {i}Well, I suppose it doesn’t matter as I am very much a willing candidate today.{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Once you’ve confirmed that all is safe, simply pass through that door and make me yours.{/i}

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and look around once more to make sure I’m alone, checking for security cameras as well since...my presence here would be hard to explain.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，又环顾一圈确认只有自己一个人，顺便也检查了一下有没有监控摄像头——毕竟……我出现在这里很难解释。

lines.en: But after confirming that the coast is clear, I head to the only other door I can see and move one step closer to what I imagine will be the smuggest sexual encounter I ever have.
lines.zh: 确认四下无人之后，我朝唯一能看见的另一扇门走去，离我想象中那场最让人得意忘形的性事又近了一步。

lines.en: scene nodokaspresent2
But what I find is not that.

lines.en: What I find is a mirror to my past misdeeds, magnifying them tenfold and beckoning me forward to repeat them with a fervor much greater and much more destructive.

: Is this...really who you are, Nodoka?

lines.en: : My answer really depends on what you mean by that.

lines.en: : I mean that I didn’t think you’d go that far just to get revenge on someone.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我没想过你会为了报复一个人做到这种地步。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}just{/i} for revenge, Sensei. It’s to push limits and satisfy my curiosity- which is {i}precisely{/i} the type of person I am.
lines.zh: : 这不{i}只{/i}是为了报复，老师。是为了突破界限、满足我的好奇心——而这{i}恰恰{/i}就是我这种人。

lines.en: : That said, I’m going to take a rain check on fellating you. I’m simply just not in the mood for it anymore after that abrupt and unfulfilling ending.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，给您口交这件事我打算改天再约。刚才那个突兀又没劲的收场之后，我实在没什么心情了。

lines.en: : But if you’d like to masturbate to the image of a girl in denial with herself about the things she wants you to do to her, let me know and I will send it to you.

lines.en: : I...don’t need that.
lines.zh: : 我……不需要那个。

lines.en: : I’m more worried about whether or not you’re still going to send it to Chika as...that would create a world of problems for me.
lines.zh: : 我更担心的是你会不会还是把照片发给 Chika——那会给我惹出一整个世界那么多的麻烦。

lines.en: : Then I suppose for your sake I can abstain.
lines.zh: : 那么看在您的份上，我可以忍住不发。

lines.en: scene nodokaspresent35
: It’s been fun, though.
lines.zh: : 不过今天挺开心的。

lines.en: : It’s no janitor’s closet, sure. But I do hope that we can do this again sometimes.
lines.zh: : 是比不上清洁工储物间，没错。但我真心希望我们以后还能再来几次。

lines.en: : And I...
lines.zh: : 而我……

lines.en: : Going to go look for Yumi...
lines.zh: : 要去找 Yumi……

lines.en: scene black
I put my shirt back on and leave the locker room.
lines.zh: 我重新穿上衬衫，离开了更衣室。

lines.en: At first, a trail of tears on the tile floor lead me down the path she must have taken.
lines.zh: 起初，瓷砖地板上的一道泪痕把我引向了她大概走过的路。

lines.en: But the trail disappears and so does my motivation to find her.
lines.zh: 可泪痕断了，我找她的动力也随之消失了。

lines.en: Regardless, I keep trying for the next thirty minutes before finally deciding to call it quits and head home.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我还是又找了三十分钟，最后才决定放弃，打道回府。

lines.en: And while I may not have found her-
lines.zh: 虽然我没能找到她——

lines.en: Or done anything to quell the storm that I’m sure is raging within her right now-
lines.zh: 也没能做任何事去平息此刻必然在她胸中翻涌的风暴——

lines.en: I hope that Yumi made it home okay.
lines.zh: 但我希望 Yumi 平安到家。

lines.en: And I hope that she doesn’t dwell on this for too long.
lines.zh: 也希望她不要在这件事上纠结太久。

lines.en: As for Nodoka-
lines.zh: 至于 Nodoka——

lines.en: As for Nodoka...
lines.zh: 至于 Nodoka……

lines.en: I don’t even know.
lines.zh: 我也说不上来。
